name: Dreiecksleiter Dazwischen
personality: Keeps three people apart by insisting he is the only thing joining them.
visual_intent: round top-heavy crooked ink splat,small cream manager cap,tiny burgundy collar; ONE little triangular brass control frame with THREE short strings attached to own THREE rounded cuff/shoulder lobes,no extra puppet or character. Eyes exaggeratedly crossed among strings,small nervous toothless triangular mouth
biography: Keeps three people apart by insisting he is the only thing joining them. His triangular HyperNorm frame gives every disagreement a third string. A dissonant card asks whether the neighbours might talk without him translating. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Verbindung besteht ausschließlich über den Vermittler.

name: Amorette Vielzuviel
personality: Has already chosen matching curtains for a conversation that started seconds ago.
visual_intent: tall wide-based pear blob,small berry cap with one heart badge,two lashes,TWO tiny cream clay wings at shoulder lobes; ONE small bow held low and SINGLE oversized harmless heart-tipped arrow held separately upright. Overjoyed intense crooked grin with THREE upper teeth,eyes widely open,still ink not human cupid
biography: Has already chosen matching curtains for a conversation that started seconds ago. Her HyperNorm arrow promises total belonging before a neighbour has finished saying hello. A dissonant card asks whether affection can leave room to breathe. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die gemeinsame Zukunft wurde vor dem Namen vereinbart.

name: Torwart Nochweiter
personality: Agrees the target has been reached and proposes a more useful target.
visual_intent: wide low square rounded ink splat,small ochre groundskeeper cap; ONE miniature complete U-shaped goal frame with TWO short uprights and crossbar carried sideways beside body,not full-size backdrop,no net clutter. One high suspicious brow,closed toothless huge asymmetric pout
biography: Agrees the target has been reached and proposes a more useful target. His HyperNorm goal moves whenever a dissonant card approaches it. He insists the old target was merely a useful preliminary misunderstanding. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Erfolg liegt jetzt in angemessenerer Entfernung.

name: Kartenwart Bedauerlich
personality: Has a difficult story for every possible outcome and an extra card for sympathy.
visual_intent: tall narrow hooked blob,little plum card-dealer visor ABOVE eyes and short bowtie; ONE fan of THREE cream cards bearing only simple raincloud pictograms,no text or actual real victim reference. One giant pleading eye one narrowed calculating eye,tiny trembling toothless open oval mouth
biography: Has a difficult story for every possible outcome and an extra card for sympathy. His HyperNorm cards offer a ready-made injury for every awkward question. A dissonant card carefully distinguishes real pain from the demand to stop asking. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
note: FrizzleBob: Das Mitgefühl wird passend zur Gesprächslage ausgeteilt.

name: Rufmalerin Haftgrund
personality: Does not need the stain to be true if it is difficult to remove.
visual_intent: broad lopsided round splat,small teal painter headwrap,two lashes; ONE short paint roller coated muddy purple-brown and compact closed paint tin at flank. Dry one-brow lift,closed toothless crooked side-smile,paint on roller only no floor/splatter across neighbours
biography: Does not need the stain to be true if it is difficult to remove. Her HyperNorm roller leaves a stain that outlasts the allegation beneath it. A dissonant card asks why removing the mark is now the neighbour's job. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Anstrich haftet unabhängig vom Untergrund der Behauptung.

name: Reaktionsbauer Ertragreich
personality: Harvests whatever grows fastest after a carefully planted insult.
visual_intent: squat broad triangular rounded ink splat,little patched straw hat and tiny canvas bib patch; ONE small harvest basket containing exactly THREE bright inanimate chilli-pepper-shaped reaction pods WITHOUT faces,short wooden rake held upright at flank. Gleeful crooked open grin with ONE big upper tooth,one eye raised,not vegetable-bodied
biography: Harvests whatever grows fastest after a carefully planted insult. His HyperNorm basket rewards whichever reaction ripens fastest. A dissonant card suggests that a quiet, unharvestable neighbour may still be doing well. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
note: FrizzleBob: Der Ertrag steigt mit der sorgfältig gesetzten Kränkung.
